chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a man who enjoys the use of a man's slave woman with his permission; he said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.اَلرِّضَا: Al-Rida (peace be upon him), the eighth Imam
key_terms.بِإِذْنِهِ: With his permission (referring to the owner)
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: He enjoys / derives benefit from (specifically sexual enjoyment in this context)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to have sexual relations with a slave woman owned by someone else?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the juristic ruling on *tamattu'* (sexual enjoyment) with a slave woman owned by another man, contingent upon the owner's permission. It underscores the flexibility of concubinage (*milk al-yamin*) in Shia fiqh, distinguishing between ownership rights and the right to derive benefit, a key topic in classical usul al-fiqh debates regarding the validity of such unions.
